body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.68 (naive sector base rate 0.67) that: Happy Forgings FY27 consolidated operating margin is >=30.0% ('broadly in line' with FY26 30.4%). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.67 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=9); SAC +3.6 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.68. Evidence: Q4FY26: margin 'broadly in line with FY26 levels' (30.4% company; screener 30.5%); Q1FY27 'upwards of 30% going forward'; Feb-26 '29-31% over the medium term'. Screener OPM Q1/Q2 FY27 31.4%/30.5%; Nov-26 flags RM/freight pressure. Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales (screener; NSE XBRL second source) is >= 30.0%, to one decimal. Source: screener.in + NSE XBRL consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.67 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=9); SAC +3.6 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.68
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=9). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales (screener; NSE XBRL second source) is >= 30.0%, to one decimal.

title: Paper call: Happy Forgings FY27 consolidated operating margin is >=30.0% ('broadly in line' with FY26 30.4%)
